name: mamba3-no-teacher-programmatic-curriculum-v1
principle: No external LLM teacher or judge. Generate deterministic tasks that directly attack Mamba state compression weaknesses.

tasks.multiple_choice_routing: Route to A/B/C/D based on exact rule.
tasks.needle_in_haystack: Retrieve a hidden key in a distractor sequence.

promotion_note: This data improves recall/copy/routing behavior only if held-out exact-match evals improve and general English quality does not collapse.
